sv.title: Larmet när badhuset i Lund stänger: ”Drabbar simkunnigheten”
sv.summary: Om ett år stänger Delphinen, ett av Lunds två badhus. Kommunen vet ännu inte hur simhallsbristen ska lösas. – Det finns en risk för sämre simkunnighet i Lund, säger simklubben Poseidons sportchef Thorbjörn Holmberg.

en.title: Alarm as Lund's swimming hall closes: "Will affect swimming ability"
en.summary: In a year, Delphinen, one of Lund's two swimming halls, will close. The municipality does not yet know how the shortage of swimming facilities will be solved. – There is a risk of poorer swimming ability in Lund, says Thorbjörn Holmberg, sports director of the swim club Poseidon.
